title: Two Lorenz trajectories, 0.001 apart
lede: The Lorenz system with σ = 10, β = 8/3 and the ρ you choose. Two trajectories start one thousandth apart; the gold one is drawn over the teal one.
notice: At ρ = 28 the gap between the two points grows by roughly a factor of ten every few time units, until it is as large as the attractor itself. That is sensitive dependence on initial conditions.
Each path alone is orderly: it keeps circling the two lobes. What cannot be predicted is which lobe it visits next, once the gap has grown.
At small ρ, such as 10, both trajectories settle to the same equilibrium point and the gap shrinks toward zero. The chaos needs ρ large enough.
hint: Drag to rotate. Change ρ, or press Reset to start both trajectories again.
